text: In 1970, Oregon had a dead whale on the beach. And a brilliant idea. Blow it up with half a ton of dynamite. The seagulls would eat the small pieces. But a blast pushes out in every direction, including straight up. That much dynamite doesn't make whale confetti. It makes whale artillery. Blubber rained down a quarter mile away and crushed a parked car. The owner had bought it in a promotion called "Get a whale of a deal." Explosives don't delete things. They relocate them.
